text:
Zoe: Quick thread: want to lock down a couple of small-but-important UX bits for Console forms before the next release. Three quick topics: compact error surfaces (chips vs inline blocks), how we signal required fields in dense tables, and a short policy for delete confirmations. Keep replies short.

Priya: Compact error chips feel less noisy in dense forms (e.g., two-line rows). They should expand on hover or focus to show the full message. For long forms keep inline blocks so errors don't get hidden.

Jun: Implementation note: error chips must still be discoverable by screen readers. Use role="alert" on the expanded content and ensure keyboard focus lands on the field first.

Rafael: For required in dense tables: prefer a tiny muted "Req" column header with an aria-label, not asterisks on every cell. For standalone inputs use '*' + sr-only "Required" so screen readers are explicit.

Sam: Agreed on both. Also proposal: show visible "Required" helper text when a field has conditional requirements (e.g., only required if X). Keeps users from missing context.

Priya: Delete confirmations: single-row deletes -> inline confirm + undo snackbar. Bulk or workspace-level destructive actions -> modal with clear consequences and typed confirm for permanent deletes.

Jun: Extra: when a bulk action affects multiple children, show a collapsed preview of affected resources in the modal (max 5) with "Show all" to avoid surprises.

Rafael: Accessibility checklist to include in the doc:
- Error chips: include aria-describedby linking to the field, expanded panel role=dialog or role=alert for message content.
- Inline errors: aria-invalid on input, role=alert on message.
- Required signals: aria-required on inputs, sr-only "Required" text when using symbolic markers.
- Delete modals: focus trap, describe restore window (e.g., Trash 30 days), typed confirm inputs should reveal characters so assistive tech can read them but should be visually masked if policy requires.

Sam: Copy suggestions:
- Error chip hover: "Invalid format: must be YYYY-MM-DD"
- Undo snackbar: "1 item moved to Trash  Undo"
- Typed confirm microcopy: "Type the name of the project to permanently delete it: \"team-site\""

Zoe: Nice. Quick decision list?
- Default: inline errors for standard forms; compact error chips for dense/list contexts; chips expand to full inline on focus.
- Required: table-level small "Req" header + aria-label; input-level '*' + sr-only. Visible "Required" helper only for conditional/complex requirements.
- Delete: inline undo for single; modal + typed confirm for permanent/bulk. Always record action in Activity/Trash so undo isn't the only recovery.

design-bot: Created task "forms/compact-errors-required-in-tables-delete-modals" -> /design-system/issues/634.

Priya: I'll add UI mocks for chips and the dense table pattern by Wednesday.

Jun: I'll draft a11y snippets and small code examples.

Rafael: I'll write the modal microcopy options.

Zoe: Great. Thanks everyone.

Sam: 👍
